posts.text: 🥇 1ST PLACE OVERALL AT HACK WESTERN 12!!!! Feels so crazy to be able to say we won. I joined this hackathon alone with no team, and honestly wasn't sure how the weekend would go. I started reaching out to people I'd never met before hoping to find a good fit. By Friday night I ended up with an incredible team of people who were sharp, super nice, and really excited to build. Excited to share that my team and I took 1st place at the Laurier Cybersecurity CTF competition! It was an incredible experience. Big shoutout to my teammates Joshua Mishra and Yanic Ballez and to the organizers for putting together such a well-run and engaging event. Looking forward to more competitions ahead!🤠 #CyberSecurity #CTF #Laurier #StudentHackers #CaptureTheFlag
